headline:
Lying on a rental
application is now
a [[felony]]
deck: House Bill 1293 makes faking your ID, pay stubs, or bank statements a crime, not just a broken lease. Landlords can now evict for it with no chance to fix it after the fact.
takeaway: Screen harder before October 1. The law will not do it for you.

stats.label: notice to vacate, no cure period
House vote in favor, zero opposed
